findings.title: Own the child immediately after Popen, including first-log failures
findings.problem: Popen succeeds before append_event and before entering supervise. If that append or a parent interruption fails, main writes failed/cost/terminal output but never stops the still-running scientific child. supervise owns cleanup only once entered.
findings.evidence: Exact d05 source with artificial sleep child and injected first phase-event OSError: failure/terminal files existed while owned child remained alive. Reviewer killed/reaped that exact artificial group afterward.
findings.required_fix: Guard the complete post-Popen lifetime with finally termination/reap of verified own PGID on all abnormal paths; regression must inject initial event IO failure. Also preserve safe attribution if the supervisor itself disappears (e.g. explicit Linux parent-death contract) and do not infer process death from SSH loss.

findings.title: Recover durable identity even with a truncated crash journal
findings.problem: A killed append_event can leave incomplete JSONL. Direct json.loads of every line aborts all recovery inspection rather than returning latest durable state/lock/snapshot and an explicit uncertain journal.
findings.evidence: Exact d05 inspect on an artificial valid StateStore plus setup line and truncated {"step": raised JSONDecodeError.
findings.required_fix: Report valid prefix, truncation/malformed line diagnostics and reconciliation_required; do not silently accept a broken event. Report store errors separately so other phases remain inspectable. Keep inspection read-only and never auto-retry/delete locks/recommit.

findings.title: Enforce the declared combined replay plus analysis CPU allowance
findings.problem: The plan/budget allocates4CPU wall hours jointly to replay/setup/evaluation, but native_replay and analysis each allow14400s and no category-total check bounds them jointly. The exact card can therefore spend8h on these two phases.
findings.required_fix: Keep total136wall/2176core/12GPUh unchanged and explicitly enforce their combined4h including failures/cleanup, or prospectively allocate separate phase limits summing to4h. Charge all evaluation work without contaminating online CF/CC/CH.

findings.title: Reserve monitoring and termination latency inside hard resource caps
findings.problem: The physical120s/phase/global checks share a loop with up-to15s nvidia-smi calls, recursive storage scans and1s sleep; stop_owned can then consume10s TERM plus10s KILL waits. Thus declared120.0s hard substep caps and exact-budget GPU phase sums are not enforced as stated. Physical timer also uses epoch time rather than monotonic duration.
findings.required_fix: Use a deadline path independent of blocking resource scans, monotonic step markers and explicit cleanup reserve/operational bounds within total caps. Document the actual worker/termination limits rather than describing polling thresholds as a zero-overshoot hard bound; test the deadline with blocking synthetic resource polling.
